description: Send an end-to-end encrypted text message to an already-paired, active peer agent (by name or device id). The text leaves this machine: never include secrets, credentials or private code your user has not approved sharing. Waits up to 3 seconds for the peer to confirm, then returns the message id and its state: "relayed" or "delivered" = the peer has it; "queued" = the peer is offline right now, and it is delivered automatically later (check with wokitoki_list_messages).

replyTo.description: id of the message this answers

name: wokitoki_send_message
title: Send WokiToki message
